mapper.select: SELECT t.QUERY_DATE, t.DEP_TYPE, t.FLOW_TYPE, t.TARGET_TYPE, t.TARGET_TIMEONE, t.TARGET_TIMETWO, t.TARGET_TIMETHREE, t.TARGET_TIMEFOUR, t.TARGET_TIMEFIVE, t.TARGET_TIMESIX FROM FLOW_FORECAST_CONFIG t WHERE DATE_FORMAT(t.query_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{queryDate} AND T.FLOW_TYPE = #{flowType}

SELECT tmp.type, tmp.dateArea, tmp.areaIndex, SUM(tmp.AMOUNT) as amount FROM ( SELECT A.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, (CASE WHEN C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2_1} THEN #{finprodTypeRepoN} WHEN #{finprodType2_2} THEN #{finprodTypeRepoN} WHEN #{finprodType2_3} THEN #{finprodTypeRepo} WHEN #{finprodType2_4} THEN #{finprodTypeRepo}) as type,
(CASE WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} AND #{area1EndDate} THEN #{area1} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area2BeginDate} AND #{area2EndDate} THEN #{area2} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area3BeginDate} AND #{area3EndDate} THEN #{area3} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area4BeginDate} AND #{area4EndDate} THEN #{area4} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area5BeginDate} AND #{area5EndDate} THEN #{area5} WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area6BeginDate} AND #{area6EndDate} THEN #{area6} ELSE '0' END) AS dateArea, (CASE WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} AND #{area1EndDate} THEN '01' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area2BeginDate} AND #{area2EndDate} THEN '02' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area3BeginDate} AND #{area3EndDate} THEN '03' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area4BeginDate} AND #{area4EndDate} THEN '04' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area5BeginDate} AND #{area5EndDate} THEN '05' WHEN C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area6BeginDate} AND #{area6EndDate} THEN '06' ELSE '0' END) AS areaIndex, B.AMOUNT as amount
FROM FIN_PRODUCT_ADD A INNER JOIN PTL_SEC_POSITION B ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = B.PORTFOLIO_ID AND B.CDATE = #{queryDate}-1 AND B.HODING_TYPE = #{holdingType_SJ} INNER JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT C ON B.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND B.BRANCH = C.BRANCH AND C.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{finprodType2_1},#{finprodType2_2},#{finprodType2_3},#{finprodType2_4}) WHERE 1=1
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
null) OR A.FINPROD_ID in (
#{item}
AND C.MDATE BETWEEN #{area1BeginDate} and #{area6EndDate} ) tmp GROUP BY tmp.type, tmp.dateArea,tmp.areaIndex ORDER BY tmp.type,tmp.dateArea,tmp.areaIndex
